content_html:
If you’re planning your visit to Machu Picchu, choosing the right clothing is essential to fully enjoy the experience. The weather can change quickly between intense sun, rain, and humidity, so being prepared is key.

In this guide, we’ll explain what to wear in Machu Picchu to stay comfortable, protect yourself from the weather, and avoid common mistakes.

You can also check the full visual guide here:
[View recommendations on Facebook]

1. Upper body clothing: protection and comfort

For your upper body, dressing in layers is the best strategy:

  • Lightweight waterproof jacket: essential for unexpected rain
  • Breathable t-shirt or top: helps prevent excessive sweating
  • Hat or cap + sunglasses: the sun at high altitude is strong

Tip: Avoid heavy clothing, as you’ll be walking a lot.

2. Lower body clothing: mobility and safety

Comfort and flexibility are key when exploring the site:

  • Comfortable, lightweight pants (preferably for trekking)
  • Avoid jeans: they are heavy and uncomfortable when wet
  • Non-slip footwear: essential for stone paths

Key tip: Make sure your shoes have good grip.

3. Essential accessories

These items will make your experience much more comfortable:

  • Reusable water bottle
  • Light snacks
  • Sunscreen
  • Insect repellent
  • Small backpack

4. Be prepared for all weather conditions

In Machu Picchu, you may experience:

  • Strong sun in the morning
  • Sudden rain
  • High humidity

That’s why dressing in layers is the best approach.

Common mistakes when dressing for Machu Picchu

  • Wearing heavy clothing
  • Using shoes without proper grip
  • Forgetting sun protection
  • Carrying too much weight

Conclusion

Choosing the right clothing for Machu Picchu can make the difference between an uncomfortable trip and an unforgettable experience. Prioritize comfort, lightness, and protection against the weather.
